scope: Production music_prompt/ClassProviders, one20s instrumental sample per style. Not normal-launch/browser/vocal or release acceptance.

good_to_go.label: Good to go
good_to_go.criteria: Recognizable requested genre and mood; acceptable to use in the assessed clip.

minor_improvement.label: Minor improvement
minor_improvement.criteria: Recognizable genre, but some detail, mood or consistency needs improvement.

major_update.label: Major update / completely misses mark
major_update.criteria: Substantially wrong, unconvincing or unusable for the requested style/mood.

rating_policy: Only Joshua listening assigns categories. Null means not yet rated, not a fourth grade. One clip is provisional; no genre-wide guarantee or automatic tuning/retry.

deferred_limitations.reason: Repeated failed listening, latest D: Still misses the target. User requested a future revisit and broader genre assessment now.

seed_policy: Unmodified production defaults. No seed/use_random_seed overrides; reported seeds are optional service metadata, not quality judgments.
count_policy: Persist attempted request count before I/O; uncertain calls are never repeated.
